{{Quote|Mother? Father?''"<br />"''Shae&hellip; child&hellip;|Shae Koda's vision of her mother and father|<ref name="DOTJ 4">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 4|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 4]]</ref>}}
The '''mother''' of [[Shae Koda]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was a member of the [[Je'daii Order]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. She and her [[Shae Koda's father|husband]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in [[25,793 BBY]], when they were defending the [[Je'daii Temples|Je'daii Temple]] [[Kaleth]] during the conflict known as the [[Despot War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|They died&mdash;''gloriously''&mdash;in the Despot War! At the gates of Kaleth, by Hadiya's hand!|[[Sek'nos Rath]], to Shae Koda|<ref name="DOTJ 4" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Je'daii Order]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the woman had a daughter named [[Shae Koda]] with her [[Shae Koda's father|husband]], another Je'daii of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomiri]] descent like her. Koda's mother was fair-skinned with [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] kept in a ponytail, wearing [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and a green triangle [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] on her forehead, and she bore her daughter sometime before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[25,805 BBY]], when the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Despot Queen]] [[Hadiya]] attempted to conquer the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] in the [[Despot War]]. Koda's parents fought the [[Despot Army]] on Tython, but both were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Hadiya at the gates of [[Kaleth]], the [[Je'daii Temples|Temple]] of Knowledge. Though the war ended with a Je'daii victory, Koda grew up an orphan and resented her parents for abandoning her. In [[25,793 BBY]], while in the [[Rift]]&mdash;a ravine on Tython saturated with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]&mdash;Koda encountered [[Force vision/Legends|visions]] of her parents and attacked them in rage.<ref name="DOTJ 4" /> In [[25,792 BBY]], Koda's parents appeared in a vision to her in the depths of the [[Chasm]] on Tython.<ref name="DOTJ 15">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 5|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 5]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Shae Koda's mother was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0]]'', a prequel issue for the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'', and she first appeared as an unnamed character in a flashback to the Despot War in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]].<ref name="DOTJ 1" /> She was first identified in a vision to Koda in [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 4|issue four]].<ref name="DOTJ 4" /> Her parents were also mentioned in the [[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2|seventh issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi|series]].<ref name="DOTJ 6">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 2]]</ref>
